mapper.select: SELECT MAIN_TICKET_ID, TICKET_LOGIC_NUM, TRANS_DATE, TRANS_AMOUNT,create_Time,businessType FROM ( select MAIN_TICKET_ID, TICKET_LOGIC_NUM, TRANS_DATE, TRANS_AMOUNT,create_Time,'tvm' AS businessType from TBL_TVM_SUB_TICKET where UPPER(TICKET_LOGIC_NUM) = UPPER(#{ticketLogicNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) UNION all select MAIN_TICKET_ID, TICKET_LOGIC_NUM, TRANS_DATE, TRANS_AMOUNT,create_Time,'bom' AS businessType from TBL_BOM_SUB_TICKET where UPPER(TICKET_LOGIC_NUM) = UPPER(#{ticketLogicNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR})) WHERE TRANS_DATE = #{transDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
